test.result: 18 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Synthetic strategy books trigger gross, net-market and pairwise-correlation risk limits; market-hedged books still retain gross exposure checks; incomplete correlation evidence is refused.

implemented: A shared book-risk aggregator totals gross and signed market exposure across named strategy books.
It computes correlation-aware risk from signed risk units and requires a complete, symmetric, bounded, positive-semidefinite correlation matrix.
Gross notional, net market exposure and correlated risk limits produce a deterministic NO_TRADE verdict when exceeded.
Hedged books may reduce net market exposure while gross exposure remains independently bounded.
blockers: The aggregator is not yet wired into PaperAccountPortfolio or every order-admission path.
Correlations and signed risk units have no point-in-time source, horizon, estimator or refresh provenance enforcement in this helper.
Portfolio cash/margin and underlying holdings are not reconciled into this risk gate.
scope_note: A tested cross-book aggregate gate exists as a callable component. Runtime enforcement, synchronized inputs and point-in-time risk provenance remain incomplete.
